title: DeregisterOldStrategiesFromSYA guards (owner-check + post-asserts) pass vacuously on a wrong-but-owned empty SYA, defeating the script's own drift protection
rootCause: The script cannot distinguish 'correctly already-clean' from 'pointed at the wrong contract': the owner-equality preflight passes (both SYAs are owner-owned) and the post-asserts only check the OLDs are ABSENT (true on an empty registry) without ever asserting they were PRESENT before removal, nor pinning the target to mainnet-addresses.ts. The script's own docstring claims it 'fails loud on the owner check' for a wrong address — false for the actual wrong-but-owned target 0x3bBE.
impact: No direct loss on its own. This is the guard-design weakness that ENABLES the Medium YS-31 brick: a wrong-but-owned empty SYA produces a fully green run with zero effect (removeYieldStrategy no-ops on _isRegistered; post-asserts pass vacuously), which is the silent-failure mechanism that lets the YS-31 brick reach production.
attackPath: 1. Step 11 is pointed at a wrong-but-owned empty SYA (0x3bBE).
4. Post-asserts pass vacuously (OLDs absent on empty registry; V2 survives).
5. A fully green run with zero effect — the silent-failure mechanism that lets the YS-31 brick reach production.
recommendation: Assert the old strategies are PRESENT on the target SYA BEFORE removeYieldStrategy (so a wrong/empty target reverts instead of no-op'ing), and pin the SYA target against mainnet-addresses.ts rather than a bare in-script constant. Tracked separately from YS-31 so this robustness remediation (assert-present-before-remove) survives even if only the address constant is fixed.
severityRationale: Low: a precondition-guard / drift weakness with no direct asset or availability loss on its own — its only consequence flows through YS-31 (Medium). Per C4, weak-guard / state-handling issues without independent impact are Low/QA. Kept distinct so the assert-present-before-remove fix is tracked independently of the address fix.
footgunRationale: Non-obvious footgun enabler: the script's own docstring claims it 'fails loud on the owner check' for a wrong address — false for the actual wrong-but-owned target. Safe-config guidance recorded with YS-31.
threeLawFraming: Law 3 in-scope non-obvious footgun (enabler of the Law-1 availability issue YS-31). Honest standalone severity Low.
relatedNote: Enabling mechanism behind the Medium YS-31 / 6f896717 (same DeregisterOldStrategiesFromSYA.s.sol, same entryPoint). Same fork evidence.
